Woderfull night at Madcow
Sep 2026 • Family
Had a really enjoyable dinner at Mad Cow Wine & Grill at Pullman Saigon Centre 30th floor . It was our first time dining here, and we were pleasantly surprised by the overall experience. The restaurant has a nice modern atmosphere with a great view, and it feels upscale without being too formal or stuffy.

We ordered the steaks and a few sides to share, and everything was really tasty. The steaks were cooked nicely and had great flavor, and the portions were quite generous. The wine selection was also good, and it was nice to be able to relax and enjoy a glass with dinner.

The service was another highlight. The staff were friendly, attentive, and helpful with recommendations, but they didn’t make us feel rushed at all. Everything was well taken care of throughout the evening. Thank to Huy Bar Captain at Madcow offered us wonderfull cocktail and big thank to all of team Vy, Nhi, Khoa, Tien

Overall, it was a great night out with good food, drinks, and a lovely atmosphere. I’d definitely recommend Mad Cow if you’re looking for a nice place for a date night, dinner with friends, or a special evening in Saigon. Would happily come back again!
